name: Interface Synthesizer (ob synthesize requirement)
description: Playable lab adaptation of the operation subset ob consumes for its synthesize role, with the settled kinds model. Retains the complete referenced schema graph; not a published shared interface revision.

kind.description: Kind identifier, exact and opaque (e.g., example.openapi@1, example.mcp@1).

KindVerdict.description: Authoritative support verdict for one exact kind identifier. Future optional fields may annotate this verdict but never qualify or soften supported.

kind.description: Exact kind identifier token as supplied by the caller.

supported.description: Strict support verdict. True warrants that this implementation implements the specification denoted by the exact kind string, as published; false is an unqualified refusal.

SynthesizeInterfaceSource.description: A binding source to synthesize an interface from.

name.description: Key name for this binding source in the output.

location.description: Location to fetch content from (path or URL).

outputLocation.description: Location to reference in the output.

embed.description: If true, embed content inline in the output.

openbindings.interface-synthesizer.listS.description: Return an advisory glance at kinds this synthesizer can name, for display, documentation, and pickers. Presence is a support warrant, and every listed identifier MUST receive supported: true from checkKindSupport. Absence carries no information and MUST NOT be treated as a negative support decision.

openbindings.interface-synthesizer.check.description: Authoritatively determine support for exact, opaque kind identifier tokens. This is the only operation a consumer may use to make a support decision such as source acceptance, refusal, or delegation. The result contains one verdict per unique input token in first-occurrence order. supported is always a strict boolean; true warrants that this implementation implements the specification the exact string denotes, as published. The result is deterministic for a given implementation version and the operation is side-effect free. An internal pattern may compress the warranted set but MUST NOT extend it: an implementation never answers true for a specification it has not implemented and never matches future revisions by prefix or regular expression. Future optional verdict fields may annotate a verdict but never qualify or soften supported.

kinds.description: Exact, opaque kind identifier tokens to check. The array may be empty.

openbindings.interface-synthesizer.synth.description: Synthesize a creation-time-sound OpenBindings interface, optionally from binding source artifacts. Every emitted binding resolves to a supported target and admits a faithful invocation path. For every accepted source input, represent every callable target admitted by its governing binding revision; an implementation may refuse an unsupported artifact as a whole but MUST refuse instead of silently returning a partial interface when one admitted target cannot be represented faithfully.
